entities.summary: The Golla are a Telugu-speaking pastoral community primarily living in the Indian states of Andhra Pradesh, Maharashtra and Telangana with smaller numbers in Karnataka and Tamil Nadu. They are related to other pastoral-herding castes like Gulla, Gullar, Gollewar and Gavli and are a part of the larger Yadav community. They are classified as a Other Backward Caste.
